bagPolicy.summary: For live music in the Great Hall, guests may bring one bag no larger than 30 × 20 × 10 cm. Oversized bags are directed to the bag drop; requirements may vary by event.
prohibited: Oversized bags in the Great Hall
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Palace car parks charge after the first 30 free minutes; Blue Badge holders park for free. East Court is normally open 5:30 a.m.–12:30 a.m. but hours vary on event days.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The palace FAQ and visitor arrival pages do not designate a rideshare pickup site.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Great Hall gig nights typically have Festival Village bars and street food vendors, and the Phoenix Bar & Pizzeria also operates on site. Sales are cashless.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Blue Badge parking is free in East Court on a first-come basis. Contact Visitor Services about accessible tickets and assistance before the concert.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The palace’s general Great Hall FAQ does not state a universal exit-and-re-entry rule for gigs.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The concert FAQ recommends showing e-tickets on a phone, but does not specify a general box-office collection procedure for Great Hall concerts.

gates.summary: Great Hall and West Hall concert entry normally uses Palm Court on the west side; check the event page for any alternative. Download e-tickets before arriving.
